image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of an adult common iguana (Iguana iguana). The subject displays characteristic features including a prominent dorsal crest with spine-like scales, a large subtympanic shield below the ear, and textured, granular skin. The coloration is predominantly greyish-brown with hints of orange, typical of mature males or specific morphs, rather than bright juvenile green. The eye is visible with a golden iris. The background appears to be a light-colored enclosure wall.
